title: Changed my life in school but ….
body:
”I can stay productive for hours with this app, it’s so simple I mean it’s just a timer, but still it makes such a difference to me, I love it!! It’s so easy to use, and it helps me remembering to take frequent breaks during study hours” - me a month ago on App Store (I gave 5 stars)

After I gave this feedback all the free advantages with noice notifications from the app was taken away? So all the noice features which helped me to stay focused and in my zone suddenly disappeared which meant I had to constantly check on the timer to know when to take a break and now I can’t use this app to study like I did before. I’m very disappointed because this app really helped me so much before due to my ADHD :( felt like a betrayal after my 5-star feedback
